reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1540 for N = 8855 receivers. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1540 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 whose length meets 1540, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. The agent used 1 code and 2 LLM calls; wall_s 27.768 (llm_s 18.913, compute_s 8.856). Baselines: CP-SAT alpha and cover timed out (~156 s), frac_cover only reached 8855 unproven, f2_minrank_sat gave nothing, and kushagra_agent also proved 1540 but took 41.6 s, so the agent was faster at equal accuracy. Caveat: LLM time dominates wall time, and the hypothesis listed no params because binomial_match was never explicitly confirmed in the record; own_rank is unavailable at N > 2500.
